Never assume your child is asleep. 🤫

Maya's family lived in a small home, and her bed was just steps away from her parents'. One night she woke up thirsty and heard whispers. She lay perfectly still, too confused to move, too confused to ask.

So she did what most kids do: she said nothing.

The cheerful girl who used to chatter at breakfast became "the shy one." She was carrying something no child should have to carry, for years.

Children don't understand everything they hear, but their minds hold onto it. 

"Lo, children are an heritage of the Lord." Psalm 127:3

Protecting their innocence is part of how we steward that heritage:
🚪 Guard what happens where your child sleeps
👀 Notice when a talkative child suddenly goes quiet
❤️ If your child opens up, don't ignore it. Listen without shame.
